meta.name: li-post
meta.description: Write a LinkedIn post from a raw idea using 21 proven hook formulas, in the user's own voice, humanized so it does not read as AI. Use whenever the user wants a LinkedIn post, a hook, a draft for the feed, "post about X", "turn this into a LinkedIn post", or asks for hook options. Produces three hook options, one full draft, and a copy-ready block that is never published without an explicit yes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把随手一个想法写成 LinkedIn 帖文,附开头钩子与可直接粘贴的草稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为领英更新发愁,想写出自然不像 AI 的帖文。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and want drafts that genuinely sound like you.

howto.what: 把一句原始想法写成 LinkedIn 帖子:先从 21 个钩子公式里挑 3 个,再按你的语气写出完整草稿,经 /li-human 处理后给出可直接粘贴的文本块。它只产出文字,不会替你发布。
howto.when: 当你想写 LinkedIn 帖子、要钩子选项,或说「把这段变成 LinkedIn 帖子」时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这周做的小工具写成一则 LinkedIn 帖子
say.note: 它会先问清发生了什么、代价或回报

say.text: 给我三个钩子选项,并说你会用哪个
say.note: 输出三条公式不同的钩子

say.text: 把这条草稿去 AI 味再给我
say.note: 经 /li-human 后给出可粘贴文本块

howto.what_en: Turns one raw idea into a LinkedIn post in your own voice: it picks 3 hooks from 21 formulas, drafts the full post, runs it through /li-human, and prints a copy-ready block. It writes text only — it never publishes for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a LinkedIn post or hook options, or say "turn this into a LinkedIn post".

say_en.text: Turn this week's internal tool into a LinkedIn post
say_en.note: It asks what happened, to whom, and the cost or return

say_en.text: Give me three hook options and say which you'd ship
Humanize this draft before showing it
say_en.note: Runs /li-human, then prints a copy-ready block
